A new Python 3.12 Kokoro environment installed 16 public hash-locked packages and newly downloaded both SHA-256-verified models, then synthesized actual audio. Actual empty-speech-runtime check produced zero footage POST attempts/tasks/reservations. Editing, voice, assets, measured profile/device, stage capability and stage-wide new-job allowance precede footage. CPU profile allows one generated sample scene, not batches. Paid speech access/quota is not proven by a credential check.
